description:
Withum is a place where talent thrives \- where who you are matters. It’s a place of endless opportunities for growth. A place where entrepreneurial energy plus inclusive teamwork equals exponential results. Withum empowers clients and our professional staff with innovative tools and solutions to address their accounting, tax and overall business management and operational needs. As a US nationally ranked Top 25 firm, we recruit only the best and brightest people with a genuine passion for the business.
 



  





 The Innovation team is seeking a hands\-on Senior DevOps Engineer in India. This role requires strong experience in Azure, Microsoft Fabric, and Power Platform to enable scalable, secure, and automated delivery of products and data analytics solutions. This role focuses on CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and platform reliability across enterprise data ecosystems.
 



  





 Withum’s brand is a reflection of our people, our culture, and our strength. Withum has become synonymous with teamwork and client service excellence. The cornerstone of our success can truly be attributed to the dedicated professionals who work here every day, whose mission is to help our clients grow and thrive – to be in a position of strength. Our commitment goes beyond our clients as we continue to live the Withum Way, promoting personal and professional growth for all team members, clients, and surrounding communities.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Design and implement CI/CD pipelines for data, BI, and Power Platform solutions
* Manage and automate deployments across Azure, Microsoft Fabric, and Power Platform environments
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform / ARM / Bicep / Pulumi CLI
* Enable version control, branching strategy, and release management using Git
* Support deployments for Power BI, Fabric artifacts, and Power Platform (Apps, Flows, Solutions)
* Implement Power Platform ALM practices (solution management, environment strategy, pipelines)
* Manage environment provisioning, promotion, and release workflows
* Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting frameworks for platform observability
* Ensure security, compliance, and access control across platforms
* Optimize deployment reliability, scalability, and performance
* Collaborate with data engineers, BI developers, and product teams
* Troubleshoot deployment and environment issues across Azure and Fabric stack
* Define and enforce DevOps standards, automation practices, and governance



  





 Requirements
 


* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Statistics, or related
* 7\-10 years of experience in technology with 5\+ years in DevOps / Platform / Cloud Engineering
* Experience working with cloud\-based data platforms (Azure / Fabric preferred)
* Exposure to multi\-domain solutions (data \+ AI \+ applications)· Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset
* Ability to translate business problems into data\-driven solutions
* Strong collaboration with engineering and business teams
* Ownership mindset with focus on impact and scalability
* Ability to work in agile, product\-driven environment



  





 Technical Skills (Must Have)
 



  





 Core Skills:
 



  





 Azure: App Services, Functions, Storage, Networking, Key Vault
 



 DevOps: Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions, CI/CD, Git strategies
 



 IaC: Terraform / Bicep / ARM
 



 Data/AI: Fabric, ADF, ML deployment lifecycle
 



 Monitoring: Application Insights, Log Analytics
 



 Security: Entra ID, RBAC, Managed Identity
 



  





 Good to Have
 


* Docker / Kubernetes
* API Management / microservices
* Event\-driven systems (Event Hub, Service Bus)
* Power Platform ALM
* Multi\-tenant / customer platform experience



  





 Website:
 
 www.withum.com
 




  





*Withum will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or because he or she is a protected veteran.*

description:
**Sr. DevOps Engineer (AWS \& Kubernetes MUST) (Ahmedabad \- onsite)** 




**Experience Level: 3\-5 years (Exp below 2 yrs and above 3 years \- DO NOT APPLY)** 




  





**Job Description:** 




 As a DevOps Engineer, you will play a critical role in the development, deployment, and maintenance of our applications and infrastructure. You will work closely with development teams, IT operations, and other stakeholders to ensure efficient, reliable, and scalable operations. Your expertise in DevOps practices, particularly with Kubernetes, will help us streamline our processes and deliver superior products.
 



  





**Requirements:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 3\-5 years of experience as a DevOps Engineer or in a similar role.
* Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes is must, including cluster management and troubleshooting.
* Proficiency in CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar.
* Experience with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Strong knowledge of containerization technologies (Docker).
* Experience with scripting and automation languages (e.g., Bash, Python, PowerShell).
* Familiarity with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).
* Understanding of monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack).



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Design, implement, and manage CI/CD pipelines to automate the build, test, and deployment processes.
* Monitor and maintain the health, performance, and security of our infrastructure and applications.
* Collaborate with development teams to understand their requirements and provide DevOps solutions that enhance productivity and quality.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to infrastructure, deployments, and system performance.
* Implement and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or similar.
* Administer and manage Kubernetes clusters, including deployment, scaling, and troubleshooting

title: DevOps Manager
description:
**Job Purpose:** 




 Lead the DevOps and Cloud Engineering function by designing secure, scalable, reliable, and cost\-effective platforms. Drive cloud strategy, automation, CI/CD, infrastructure, Kubernetes, observability, security, reliability, and engineering excellence while mentoring teams and partnering with technical and business stakeholders.
 



  





**Who You Are:** 



* 10\+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud, SRE, Platform Engineering, or Infrastructure, with 2\+ years in a Technical Lead or Manager role.
* Strong experience designing and managing AWS and Azure cloud environments and production infrastructure.
* Strong expertise in CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Git, release management, and deployment strategies.
* Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, Docker, container orchestration, scaling, and production operations.
* Strong understanding of cloud networking, VPC/VNet, DNS, load balancing, firewalls, routing, security groups, and connectivity.
* Experience with infrastructure and automation using Terraform, Infrastructure\-as\-Code, scripting, and configuration management.
* Strong experience with S3, RDS, MongoDB, MySQL, MS SQL, Redis, Kafka/MSK, and CloudWatch.
* Experience building observability platforms using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Elastic Stack, logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting.
* Strong understanding of DevSecOps, IAM, secrets management, vulnerability management, backup, disaster recovery, high availability, and business continuity.
* Experience managing production incidents, RCA, capacity planning, performance optimization, and operational readiness.
* Strong leadership and people\-management skills, including mentoring, hiring, performance development, technical reviews, and team growth.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills with the ability to translate technical challenges into business outcomes.



  





**What Will Excite Us:** 



* Experience defining and implementing DevOps and cloud strategy across multiple engineering teams and environments.
* Experience establishing engineering standards for CI/CD, Infrastructure\-as\-Code, Kubernetes, security, monitoring, and operational excellence.
* Strong experience with cloud migration, platform modernization, high availability, scalability, and disaster recovery.
* Experience implementing DevSecOps across the software delivery lifecycle, including security scanning, vulnerability management, compliance, and secure software supply chains.
* Experience driving cloud cost optimization, resource governance, capacity planning, and FinOps practices.
* Strong understanding of SRE principles, SLIs/SLOs, incident management, reliability engineering, and continuous improvement.
* Experience leading technical architecture reviews, platform roadmaps, POCs, and large infrastructure initiatives.
* Experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities into engineering, automation, operational, or developer\-platform workflows.
* Ability to evaluate new technologies and establish practical standards without unnecessary complexity.



  





**What Will Excite You:** 



* Opportunity to own and shape the organization's DevOps, Cloud Engineering strategy.
* Lead a high\-performing DevOps team and build a strong culture of ownership, automation, reliability, and continuous improvement.
* Architect modern cloud\-native platforms across AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, and containerized environments.
* Drive improvements across CI/CD, observability, security, scalability, reliability, and infrastructure automation.
* Work closely with Engineering, QA, Security, Product, and Leadership teams to deliver reliable and scalable platforms.
* Lead challenging cloud migrations, production transformations, and platform modernization initiatives.
* Build a long\-term roadmap for automation, operational excellence, and next\-generation engineering practices.



  





**Location: Ahmedabad (WFO)**
